newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance to meet for bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance to meet for bonus issue.

text.p: Leading Indian petrochemicals maker Reliance Industries Ltd will meet to consider a bonus equity issue of shares, sources close to the company told Reuters on Thursday.
"The board is meeting on June 26 for a bonus," the source said.
Reliance shares surged 14 rupees, or more than four percent, to 335 on the Bombay bourse on the news.
Reliance shares have risen around 60 percent this year on the back of large capacity additions, increased profits and hopes of a bonus share issue.
A company spokesman confirmed that the firm's board would meet to consider a bonus.
The company is also due to hold its annual shareholders meeting on that day. The spokesman said he did not know what time the board meeting would be held.
